profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Scalable Services | Ex-Uber
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience specializing in distributed systems, high-availability cloud infrastructure, and backend services at Microsoft (Azure Storage) and Uber.
Tech Stack:
C++, C#, Go, Java, Python, SQL | Distributed Systems, High Availability, Microservices, Concurrency, REST APIs | Azure Storage, Cassandra, MySQL, Redis, Apache Spark

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Azure Storage - XStore (XAggregator / FE):

• Elastic SAN Plus (ESAN+) Usage Reporting: Designed and implemented telemetry reporting APIs in XAggregator to aggregate and report resource consumption metrics (ingress, egress, IOPS), enabling accurate quota enforcement and customer billing across clusters.
• Geo EC Tier Throttling: Engineered an automated throttling engine in XAggregator and Managed FE to pace SetBlobTier requests dynamically, preventing node overload and eliminating cross-region egress cost spikes.
• Account Settings Management: Architected the Account Settings framework and RESTful XDS APIs, decoupling global tenant-wide dynamic configurations into per-account properties to streamline migrations, enforce limits, and minimize blast radiuses.
• Dynamic Configuration Refactoring: Authored automation tooling and parsing scripts to standardize hundreds of legacy XML configs to a macro-based schema, preventing configuration drift across production clusters.
• Live-Site Sev2 Incident Mitigation: Engineered and validated Geneva Actions for real-time SNI blocking dynamic config updates, empowering on-call teams to atomically mitigate malicious traffic with zero regressions.

Technologies: C++, C#, Azure Storage (Blob, Table, XStore, XAggregator), Microservices, Distributed Systems, Multithreading, RPC, REST APIs, Geneva Telemetry & Metrics.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · C++ · C# · Microsoft Azure · High Availability (HA)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Rider Incentives & Promotion Engineering:

• Bulk Campaign Platform: Architected full-stack backend APIs and administrative tooling enabling operations teams to launch ~500 customized promotional campaigns weekly for Uber Riders and Uber Eats globally.
• ML Promotion Pipelines: Integrated Flowbulk services into Sapphire (ML-driven personalized promotion engine), slashing campaign batch processing times from ~24 hours to ~2 hours across hundreds of millions of users while dramatically reducing on-call alerts.
• Low-Latency Real-Time Promotion Engine: Engineered core RPC logic for real-time location-based airport promotions, maintaining strict sub-300ms SLA latencies across high-throughput request streams.
• Distributed Systems Reliability: Hardened worker pipelines and data processing across Cassandra, MySQL, and Presto to eliminate query bottlenecks and improve service availability.

Technologies: Go, Python, React, Redux, Cassandra, MySQL, AWS, Presto, Apache Spark, Kafka, Microservices.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Apache Kafka · Apache Spark · Microservices · Python

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Directory & Identity Provisioning Team:

• Performance Optimization: Redesigned the User Admin interface and modernized backend endpoints using GraphQL and React, achieving up to 20x latency reductions for administrative directory lookups.
• Security & Vulnerability Remediation: Hardened identity provisioning microservices by auditing and patching critical vulnerabilities, including SQL injection, API rate-limiting weaknesses, cross-site scripting (XSS), and directory traversal vectors.

Technologies: Ruby on Rails, React, JavaScript, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, Docker.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Apollo GraphQL · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · PostgreSQL · Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Product Development & Video Platform:

• Media Management Architecture: Engineered core UI components and state management architecture for Backlot video management using React, Redux, Reselect, and Immutable.js, optimizing asset publishing and monetization workflows.
• API Integration: Integrated frontend clients with distributed media ingestion APIs, improving UI responsiveness and state synchronization.

Technologies: React, Redux, JavaScript, Java, REST APIs.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Redux.js · JavaScript · Front-End Development · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
TimesTen In-Memory Database Team:

• Database Administration Tooling: Engineered SQL Developer plugin integrations using Java and JDBC for TimesTen In-Memory Database, simplifying complex memory tuning and database configuration workflows.

Technologies: Java, JDBC, SQL Developer, Linux.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JDBC · Linux · Relational Databases · SQL

volunteerExperiences.description:
Participated in sea turtle conservation initiatives at Chalacatepec beach, a federally protected marine sanctuary in Jalisco, Mexico (Dec 2013 and Jun 2015).

Responsibilities included night patrols for nesting turtles, safely relocating eggs to protected hatcheries, and releasing hatchlings back into the sea to ensure survival rates.

projects.title: Game Hunter
projects.description:
Capstone full-stack web application designed for aggregating, searching, and discussing video game metadata:

• Integrated GiantBomb REST APIs to ingest and query external game catalogs, media, and release data in real time.
• Built reactive client interfaces and discussion feeds utilizing WebSocket connections (Socket.io) for live user comments and updates.
• Implemented full-stack architecture using the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, AngularJS, Node.js) with build automation via Grunt and Yeoman.
